subject: Simple Dynamic linear model with rstan

messages.author: f27137f2237cce3a
messages.subject: Simple Dynamic linear model with rstan
parts:
I am new to stan. I am trying to fit Dynamic linear model using Stan. 

Y_{it} denotes state at i th account at time t. It is a vector of size p. \theta_{it} is a vector of states which is vector of p.

Y_{it} = \theta_{it} + \nu_{it}

\theta_{it} = \theta_{i(t-1)} + \epsilon_{it}

 \nu_{it} ~ normal (0, sigmav^2_i I_{p,p})

\epsilon_{it} ~ normal (0, sigmae^2_i  I_{p,p})

sigmav^2_i ~ inverse-gamma(0.001, 0.001)

sigmae^2_i ~ inverse-gamma(0.001, 0.001)

But my problem is that all Y_i does not contain equal number of time points. Some Y_i's have 500 time points and some has 20 time points.So, I can't store it in a 3-D array. (n * p * 500)


My data looks like:

Account        Var 1         Var 2 ...................Var p

1
1
2
2
2
2
2
3
3
.
.
.
I wrote the stan code for i=1 or one account and it's working. But I could not figure out how to store unbalanced data. 

DLMmodel=
  'data
{
  int<lower=1> n;
  int<lower=1> p; 
  matrix[p,n] Y;
}
parameters
{
matrix[p,n] thetavec;
real<lower=0> sigmav;
real<lower=0> sigmaw;
}

model
{
  for (i in 1:n) 
  Y[,i] ~ normal(thetavec[,i] , sigmav);
  for (i in 2:n)
  thetavec[ ,i] ~ normal(thetavec[,i-1],sigmaw);
}'
